title: Safety of Household, Commercial and Similar Electrical Appliances (Quality Control) Order, 2026
issuing_authority: DPIIT, Ministry of Commerce and Industry
summary: Notified as S.O. 1739(E) dated 6 April 2026, superseding the 2025 order. Makes BIS certification under IS 302 (Part 1):2024 mandatory for around 90 household, commercial and similar electrical appliance categories before sale or import in India, effective 1 October 2026. Applies to both domestic and foreign manufacturers.

title: Aluminium and Aluminium Alloy Products (Quality Control) Order, 2026
issuing_authority: DPIIT, Ministry of Commerce and Industry
summary: Notified as S.O. 1319(E) dated 11 March 2026, superseding the 2025 order. Mandates BIS certification (ISI mark) for 17 aluminium and aluminium alloy product categories. Table 1 products took effect 11 March 2026; Table 2 products carry staggered deadlines — 1 December 2026 for general/large enterprises, 1 March 2027 for small and 1 June 2027 for micro enterprises.

title: Transition Facilitation (Quality Control) Order, 2026
issuing_authority: DPIIT, Ministry of Commerce and Industry
summary: Notified 25 June 2025, effective 19 March 2026. Provides an alternative compliance pathway: eligible manufacturers covered under specified QCOs (toys, footwear, furniture, air-conditioners, among others) may obtain a BIS Standard Mark licence under Scheme II for supplying to specifically permitted companies, without full conventional certification, subject to DPIIT approval and time-bound validity. This is a concession mechanism, not a new mandatory standard.

title: Room Air Conditioners (Quality Control) Order, 2022 (Unitary Air Conditioners)
issuing_authority: Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution (BIS)
summary: Notified 21 December 2022 with enforcement postponed to 1 October 2023. All unitary (window) room air conditioners must conform to IS 1391 (Part 1):2017 and bear the ISI mark before sale, import or distribution in India.

title: Room Air Conditioners (Quality Control) Amendment Order, 2025
issuing_authority: DPIIT, Ministry of Commerce and Industry
summary: Issued 11 February 2025, extending mandatory BIS certification to split air conditioners under IS 1391 (Part 2):2017, with implementation from 8 May 2026. Related orders cover hermetic compressors and temperature-sensing controls used in ACs.

title: Hermetic Compressors and Related Parts (Quality Control) Order
issuing_authority: DPIIT, Ministry of Commerce and Industry
summary: Makes BIS certification mandatory for hermetic compressors and temperature-sensing controls used in air conditioners and refrigeration, enforced from 29 December 2023, with import relaxations for compressors extended until March 2027.

title: Toys (Quality Control) Order, 2020
issuing_authority: DPIIT, Ministry of Commerce and Industry
summary: Effective 1 September 2020. Prohibits manufacture, sale, import and distribution of toys for children under 14 that do not conform to IS 9873 (Parts 1–4) and IS 15644 (electric toys) and carry the ISI mark. Compliance with updated 2020-2022 editions of the IS 9873 parts is required.

title: Toys (Quality Control) Second Amendment Order, 2020
issuing_authority: DPIIT, Ministry of Commerce and Industry
summary: Second amendment to the Toys QCO, dated 11 December 2020, refining requirements for non-electric toys under IS 9873 and transition arrangements for existing stock.

title: Domestic Pressure Cooker (Quality Control) Order, 2020
issuing_authority: DPIIT, Ministry of Commerce and Industry
summary: Issued 21 January 2020, effective 1 August 2020. All domestic pressure cookers must conform to IS 2347:2017 and bear the ISI mark under a BIS licence before sale, import or distribution in India.

title: Electronics and Information Technology Goods (Requirements for Compulsory Registration) Order, 2012 (CRS)
issuing_authority: MeitY (Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology)
summary: The founding CRS order, with category-wise phased compliance from 3 July 2013. Requires self-declaration of conformity (tested by BIS-recognised labs) and registration with BIS before sale — electronics from mobile phones and power banks to LED TVs, batteries, LED lamps and solar PV modules. Note: CRS registration is a distinct regime from ISI licensing.

title: CRS revision — Self-ballasted LED lamps: IS 16102 (Part 1):2026 supersedes the 2012 edition
summary: Revised standard IS 16102 (Part 1):2026 became effective 2 February 2026 for self-ballasted LED lamp registration; registrations against the 2012 edition remain valid until 2 August 2026, after which manufacturers must transition to the 2026 edition.

title: Cement (Quality Control) Order, 2003
issuing_authority: Department of Industrial Policy and Promotion (now DPIIT)
summary: One of the earliest sectoral QCOs — mandatory BIS certification (ISI mark) for cement sold in India since 2003, covering OPC 33/43/53, PPC, slag and white cement. Dates for individual amendments should be verified in the Gazette via the tracker linked.

title: Steel and Steel Products (Quality Control) Order, 2012
issuing_authority: Department of Industrial Policy and Promotion (now DPIIT)
summary: Mandatory BIS certification for major steel products, implemented in phases between 2012 and 2016 across different product categories (reinforcement bars, structural steel, tubes, sheets). Amended multiple times since, most recently in 2026.

title: DPIIT tranche announcement: 58 new QCOs covering 315 product standards
issuing_authority: DPIIT, Ministry of Commerce and Industry
summary: Policy context for the Regulatory Change Radar: DPIIT announced a tranche of 58 new Quality Control Orders covering 315 product standards, signalling the sustained pace at which new product categories are brought under mandatory BIS certification.
